text:
erin: Quick announcement: we are rolling out the new Hosted API async-run preview today for select orgs. Purpose: background tool integrations and long-running jobs where streaming isn't ideal. Docs: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/async-preview :tada:

mike: Nice. Is there a new SDK surface?

erin: Yes, Node + Python preview SDKs include AsyncClient.create_run and poll_run. Example in docs.

jisoo: How do we opt in?

erin: Toggle in Console -> Settings -> Feature Previews or include header X-Preview-Feature: async-run. Preview keys will be provisioned for flagged orgs.

mike: Any rate limits I should warn customers about?

erin: Preview limits: 10 concurrent runs/org, 3000 run creations/day. Callback retry up to 5 attempts with exponential backoff. We'll surface quotas in the Console.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: async-run-preview v0.1 -> us-west-2. Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/async-preview :gear:

jisoo: Observability question: will runs appear in Console traces?

erin: Yes 12 Observability -> Async Runs shows lifecycle, costs, and callback status.

mike: GA ETA?

erin: Targeting GA in ~6 weeks after EA feedback. We'll post migration guides and patch notes in the docs repo. Join the demo tomorrow 9am PT.
